origin.description: A developer wanted to understand how computer time was spent. The same need extends to personal Mac users and parents seeking open accountability around school and leisure.
origin.copyDirection: Curiosity, clarity and shared conversations. Avoid productivity scores, moral judgments, hidden surveillance or claiming to prove attention.

verifiedImplementation.claim: Universal foreground-application sessions, with separate timestamps and durations
Daily application totals, a seven-day summary and expandable application → website → recorded metadata hierarchy
A selectable Activity Timeline and Activity Journal with recorded usage, observed inactivity, confirmed normal quits and inferred interruptions
Idle, sleep/display/account inactivity, paused, unavailable and unrecorded intervals remain distinct from active totals
Transactional local SQLite checkpoints, recovery after interruptions and explicit unknown gaps; no fabricated activity before monitoring
Recording starts only after the first-use Start recording acknowledgement; Not now leaves recording stopped
Optional, visible Guardian Mode protects administrative controls, history deletion and optionally normal quitting
Retention choices are 30, 90, 365 days or no automatic expiry; 90 days is the default

records: monitoring gaps, checkpoints and lifecycle journal
separately opted-in page titles and YouTube identifiers

permissions.optionalBrowserDetails: Per-browser Enable action and normal macOS Automation consent

privacy.browserDefaults: Chrome and Safari metadata are off by default; page titles and YouTube identifiers are additional off-by-default choices.
privacy.urlRules: Store canonical website origin; discard arbitrary paths, queries, fragments and credentials. Optional allowlisted YouTube identifier is the limited exception.
privacy.chromePrivate: Native private-window mode checked before and after reading; full live incognito validation remains outstanding.
privacy.safariPrivate: No verified native private-window flag; users must disable Safari website details before private browsing.
privacy.storageProtection: SQLite database in local application container; not separately encrypted by TimeScope. macOS account/file protection and user backups apply.
privacy.guardianCredential: Salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 verifier and retry state in macOS Keychain; no plain passcode persistence.
privacy.publicWebsiteAndEmail: Website hosting technical logs and voluntary support email are separate from offline app collection.

measurementAndFamilyBoundaries: Foreground app or sampled website exposure is not proof of watching, reading, attention or productivity.
A macOS account UID does not identify the individual using a shared account.
Guardian Mode does not prevent Force Quit, shutdown, uninstalling or normal operating-system management.
There is no remote parent dashboard, schedule enforcement, app blocking, family account system or online passcode reset.
Passive video viewing can become idle; dedicated lock/unlock detection remains unverified.
Browser details are sampled and can miss quick tab changes; missing observations stay unclassified.
Website time is a component of parent app time, not additional computer time. Conflicting overlaps remain unclassified.
Stored content fields do not imply collected channels or independent content durations; current content records lack independent start/end timestamps.
